We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Sales Specialist to drive the growth of our Cortex and Cloud business in the region.

They will have a proven track record of developing strong customer relationships and executing strategies that support rapid expansion and success. This role requires a strategic thinker who excels in collaboration with internal teams, engages effectively with customers, and drives revenue growth through the sale of complex solutions.
q: 5+ years of field sales experience focusing on key customer accounts and delivering value to enterprise accounts.

d: The Senior Associate Service Delivery supports the Senior Manager – Service Delivery in ensuring seamless frontline execution of the SHARE Loyalty Programme across all customer touchpoints in Oman.
The role contributes to three main areas
Service Delivery: maintaining operational excellence and consistency across Business Units (BUs).
Training: supporting the rollout, coordination, and tracking of training and knowledge initiatives for frontline teams.
Ambassador Programme: driving the setup, engagement, and recognition of SHARE Ambassadors in Oman, ensuring alignment with the overall programme vision and standards across Majid Al Futtaim.
Support the implementation of loyalty-related SOPs, service standards, and processes across customer-facing teams.
Coordinate with business units to identify service gaps, gather frontline feedback, and drive corrective actions to enhance customer experience.
Monitor service performance through reports, audits, dashboards, and KPIs to ensure consistent service quality.
Assist in planning, scheduling, and tracking SHARE training programs across Oman, including attendance, evaluations, and training logistics.
Support learning and development initiatives, including micro-learning tools, induction programs, refresher sessions, and knowledge audits.
Coordinate and manage the SHARE Ambassador Programme, including onboarding, communications, engagement activities, and participation tracking.
Drive Ambassador engagement through competitions, feedback campaigns, recognition initiatives, and success-story sharing.
Consolidate operational data and prepare reports on training, ambassador engagement, and service delivery KPIs, highlighting trends and improvement opportunities.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or related field.
2–4 years of experience in service operations, customer experience, or training support.
Experience in loyalty programmes or retail operations preferred.
Excellent communication and stakeholder coordination skills.
Strong written and verbal communication in English and Arabic.
Comfortable working with data tracking tools, digital platforms, and dashboards.
